name: KITTI Vision Benchmark Suite
description: A pioneering mobile robotics and autonomous driving vision benchmark suite captured by the Karlsruhe Institute of Technology and Toyota Technological Institute at Chicago. Recorded from a Volkswagen Passat station wagon equipped with two high-resolution color and grayscale video cameras, a Velodyne HDL-64E rotating 3D laser scanner, and an RTK GPS/IMU navigation system. Provides challenging real-world benchmarks for stereo matching, optical flow, visual odometry, 3D object detection, and road segmentation in urban, rural, and highway traffic.
